name: Salesforce sf-skills Data 360 Companion Contract
purpose: Machine-readable contract for using the Salesforce sf-skills repository as a Data 360 execution and debugging companion to Data360 Beast without vendoring upstream skill content.

installPolicy.vendoring: Do not vendor upstream skill bodies into Data360 Beast. Fetch the selected upstream skill folders at install time.

namingPolicy.upstreamExactNames: Keep upstream folder names unchanged when installing or linking to forcedotcom/sf-skills.
namingPolicy.allowedLegacyUse: Use Data Cloud only when quoting upstream skill names, upstream metadata, CLI/plugin compatibility text, historical source names, or user-provided text.

authorityRules: Data360 Beast is the authority for source hierarchy, proof labels, official-doc routing, limits precedence, OpenAPI discipline, public-safe Labs promotion, and confidence.
sf-docs remains the authority path for current Salesforce Help and Developer documentation.
The Salesforce sf-skills companion helps plan execution and debugging paths for sf data360 command workflows.
Actual org actions happen through approved CLI, MCP, API, metadata, or helper tools after Beast preflight confirms authorization.
Do not treat forcedotcom/sf-skills as official Data 360 documentation.
Do not treat a successful sf data360 command as proof outside its matching phase without Beast readback requirements.

companionSkills.purpose: Multi-phase setup, readiness classification, data spaces, data kits, and cross-phase troubleshooting.
Connection, connector, source discovery, connector metadata, and connection health command workflows.
Data stream, DLO, transform, document processing, and ingestion command workflows.
DMO, mapping, relationship, identity resolution, data graph, profile, and universal ID command workflows.
Segment, calculated insight, publish, count, and audience troubleshooting command workflows.
Activation, activation target, data action, data action target, and destination setup command workflows.
Data 360 SQL, async query, table describe, search index, vector search, and hybrid search command workflows.
DLO and DMO schema inspection helpers for target-org metadata discovery.
Data 360 code extension development, local test, scan, and deployment workflows.

executionLoop: Think with Beast preflight, phase routing, sf-docs, OpenAPI, Beast specialists, proof ledger, and selected sf-skills companion guidance.
Act with approved MCP, API, CLI, metadata, or helper tools only after org, data space, permissions, available tools, and mutation approval are clear.
Prove with returned ID, status, count, data space, metadata, query result, log, event, or delivery signal.
Learn by promoting only distilled public-safe evidence into Beast; keep scenario bodies and org-connected experiments in Labs.
weeklyWatchRules: Check only the approved companionSkills list for upstream drift.
Update this contract when upstream changes affect install, routing, command behavior, templates, readiness checks, or gotchas.
Do not copy upstream skill bodies into Beast.
Run the installer in dry-run mode as a health check.
